content:
nina: Planning a rolling reboot + NIC micro-patch for gpu-uscentral on 2026-06-01 01:00-04:00 UTC. We'll do canary (1 rack) -> 4-cohort sweep with staged backfill to eu-west1. Need KV warmseed after each rack.

arjun: Expected capacity hit? and any Dedicated tenant impacts?

nina: Expect ~18% capacity dip during sweep. Dedicated tenants with pinned zones get direct comms; hosted traffic will be steered. No data plane changes.

mel: Suggested sequence: drain -> reboot -> kvseed -> health-check -> uncordon. Use `./ops drain --rack=r22 --grace=60s`.

arjun: Cost estimate for cross-region backfill ~ $2.1k baseline, +$1.8k if extended. Recommend cost gate at $3.5k.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance_id=UC-20260601-01 window=01:00-04:00 UTC pools=[gpu-uscentral] runbook=<https://go/redwood/runbooks/uscentral-reboot|runbook>

mel: Oncall: nina primary, arjun backup. Be available 00:30-04:30 UTC. I'll post canary checklist 45m before.

arjun: Add automation watch: pause if p95>2s for 10m or errors>2% for 10m. Manual pause only per product.

pager-bot: reminder set for 2026-06-01T00:15:00Z to confirm customer comms.

nina: Draft comms posted to #acct-dedicated. Will send 12h prior. Final checklist incoming. :thumbsup:
